Winter is Coming!

We hope you enjoyed the false spring, because the freezer door opens tonight! Our snowmakers plan to hit the hill at 3am, and will keep blowing snow as long as possible. Ma Nature is predicted to chip in on her end as well, with the current forecast calling for snow to fall later this week! We are still aiming to open Friday, but may push back to Saturday if our snowmaking team needs an extra day. Get those snow dances going!

Last week was busy at Bromley, with the return of our winter seasonal staff, and continuing preparations for the opening day of our 90th season! Lift Maintenance has been out greasing the wheels on our chairlifts, our rentals & tuning staff have been putting the finishing touches on their big summer renovation, and Ski School & Mighty Moose folks are back on-site, getting into the swing of things. 

Speaking of the 90th anniversary, we would love to hear your favorite memories in honor of this major milestone. Help us celebrate and honor 90 years of Bromley and Submit Your Story. 

To stay up to date on the latest news, updates, and offers, make sure you Sign Up for our Newsletter!

Rusty Edges? Dry bases? Rentals & Repairs is open Wednesday- Sunday, 10 a.m.- 4 p.m. for all your pre-season needs.

Lessons Now Available - Whether it's your first time ever or first time in a while, we've got you covered with flexible lesson options. Try our Adult Group Lessons (new this year!) Where skiers and boarders 13+ can learn alongside others with a similar skill level in a supportive environment.

26/27 Season Passes: Ski/ride on the sunny side this winter. Lock in your Bromley pass for season-long fun in the sun.

Ikon Session 3-Day: As an added perk, Bromley Unlimited Passholders are eligible to purchase a heavily discounted Ikon Session 3-Day Pass.

Preferred Parking Permit: Save your legs for the slopes and guarantee a closer spot in our monitored preferred parking lot. (General parking is always free at Bromley)
